dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: So, next on the agenda... Eh? Is this all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's work coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: My father's been getting on in years lately, so I asked for a transfer. Now that I'm in a more leisurely department, I finally have time to spend with my family after work.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Now that I have some room to breathe, I can't even recall how I managed to take on so many tasks... Many of them weren't even my responsibilities, but I just couldn't help putting my nose in there.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Hahaha. I was so strong back then, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: See you. I guess I've got to learn to fret a little less and do a little less...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The "past" you?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: *sigh* Did you ever spend Lantern Rite here in Liyue? I was the previous planner of the event.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Of course, Lantern Rite is the biggest festival of the year; everyone in Liyue Harbor comes out to celebrate it together. One planner can't handle an event of that magnitude...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: But Liyue Harbor's high population and complex environment means that there are still very many issues for each planner to consider...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Like the lack of guardrails at the wharf, the crowding at food stalls in Chihu Rock, the cats and dogs and running around all over the place... There's so much to consider!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: ...No, no, I'm starting to think like a planner again. That's not my job anymore — I should just get off work and go take care of my father.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: They should put up more railings around the docks. What if someone falls into the sea during the festive period?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: ...And there's the fire hazards. Feiyun Slope should be okay, but here at Chihu Rock it's difficult to have eyes everywhere once the place gets crowded...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: More people means more torches... I need to write a report to warn them about this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: ...We also can't have too much restaurant seating spilling out into the streets, it would be a total disaster if someone were to get trampled...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: But how do we explain that to the restaurants? Ugh, there's so many things to juggle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, can you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Oh! Goodness! I almost forgot... All those cats and dogs around the harbor need somewhere to stay...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: There's a thought; Yong'an is always on duty here, and he loves cats and dogs. So does Manager Xiao. I wonder if they'd be happy to help...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you alone...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm... What if people can't see the lantern? How will we manage the flow of pedestrians...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Any pickpockets loitering around will simply disappear into the crowd, where even the Millelith will be powerless to track them down...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: We've got to think carefully about where we station our police officers too... Oh, are you talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: ...Hi. I'm Jiangzhou, planner for the Lantern Rite festival... Well, one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One of them?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Yes... Lantern Rite is the biggest festival of the year; everyone in Liyue Harbor comes out to celebrate it together. One planner can't handle an event of that magnitude...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Even then, Liyue Harbor's high population and complex environment means that there are still very many issues for each planner to consider...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: And of course, the number one priority of this job is to not end up creating any new problems...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New problems?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Yes... Sometimes due to lack of communication, one planner ends up reversing a decision made by another planner, which wastes time and resources.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: For instance, I had to repeatedly stress the other day that we need to add a street light here... Huh? Where's the street light?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: This is no good, I'll definitely be writing a report about this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye, sorry for disturbing you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... Boss, another round of bar snacks, please!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I hope it all goes smoothly, and nothing bad happens...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! Welcome to the Lantern Rite Gala.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: I'm one of the Lantern Rite planners, acting on behalf of the planning committee.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: A whole year's worth of planning just for this moment. I'm so excited I could cry!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Please Lantern Rite, go off without a hitch!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangzhou
dialogues.text: Have fun! Have no regrets, and enjoy Lantern Rite!
